title: Zero to First Agent with Anthropic/Claude

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI and C-Sharp video about Zero-to-First Agent, where I'm going to show you how to use Entropiq's Claude in Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，這支從零到第一個代理程式的 C# AI 影片，會示範如何在 Microsoft Agent Framework 使用 Anthropic Claude。

cues.en: So I'm going to start with a blank console app here.
cues.zh: 我們先從空白主控台應用程式開始。

cues.en: And I only have a few steps here.
cues.zh: 只需要幾個步驟。

cues.en: In this, I'm just in an empty app here.
cues.zh: 目前這裡是完全空白的應用程式。

cues.en: But in real life, you will be able to see these samples up on my Microsoft Agent Framework repo sample repository,
cues.zh: 完整範例之後也能在我的 Microsoft Agent Framework 範例儲存庫中找到，

cues.en: which is linked in the description.
cues.zh: 連結放在影片說明。

cues.en: But in order for us to work with Entropiq and Claude, we need to, of course, have an account with Entropiq up in their system.
cues.zh: 要使用 Anthropic 與 Claude，當然先需要 Anthropic 帳號。

cues.en: So we can go to this URL, or just search for Claude API keys, and it will send you to here where you can go and do it.
cues.zh: 可以到這個網址，或搜尋 Claude API Keys，進入相關頁面。

cues.en: And here, there will be a console link.
cues.zh: 這裡有 Console 連結。

cues.en: And if you press that console link, it will end up in your account, where you need to add a few funds.
cues.zh: 點進去會到自己的帳號，先儲值一些額度。

cues.en: You need to add minimum at $5 before you can test.
cues.zh: 至少儲值五美元，才能測試。

cues.en: But once you're here, you need to go to API keys and create a new key.
cues.zh: 進入後，到 API Keys 建立新金鑰。

cues.en: And let's just call it AF sample.
cues.zh: 名稱就叫 AF Sample。

cues.en: This, and since this is a key I don't want to expose and show, I'm just going to make it for three hours.
cues.zh: 因為不想長期公開這把金鑰，我只讓它有效三小時。

cues.en: But in real life, you will probably set it to custom or never.
cues.zh: 實際使用通常會自訂期限，或設定不過期。

cues.en: Because I'm going to show this key, but at the time you see this recording, that key will not be valid anymore.
cues.zh: 影片裡會看到金鑰，但你觀看時它已經失效。

cues.en: So, of course, create your keys and secrets.
cues.zh: 正式使用當然應妥善管理金鑰與秘密設定。

cues.en: But for the sake of this video, I will show it here.
cues.zh: 這裡只是為了示範才顯示。

cues.en: So we got our key, and in this case, I will also put it down here in the description.
cues.zh: 現在取得金鑰，在這個範例裡先直接放進來。

cues.en: And I'm just going to make it for three hours.
cues.zh: 同樣只設定三小時效期。

cues.en: But in real life, you will probably set it to custom or never.
cues.zh: 實際應用則可能使用自訂期限或不過期。

cues.en: Directly in code, of course, we should put it in user secrets and vibrant variables or key walls before we can do this.
cues.zh: 示範暫時直接寫在程式碼，但正式使用應放進 User Secrets、環境變數或 Key Vault。

cues.en: The other thing we need is a model that we're going to use.
cues.zh: 另外需要指定模型。

cues.en: And if we don't know the models, up here, we can also go to playground.
cues.zh: 如果不知道模型名稱，也可以到 Playground。

cues.en: And here we can see the different models that we can connect to.
cues.zh: 這裡能看到可連接的模型。

cues.en: So if you hover the mouse over one of them and press here, you essentially just copy the model ID.
cues.zh: 滑鼠移到模型上，再點這裡，就能複製模型 ID。

cues.en: So we're going to use Cloud Opus 5.5 here.
cues.zh: 這次使用 Claude Opus 5.5。

cues.en: But of course, any of the models will work.
cues.zh: 當然也可以選其他模型。

cues.en: Now we need a NuGet package.
cues.zh: 接著需要 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: We need the Microsoft Agent Framework for Entropic.
cues.zh: 也就是 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 Anthropic 套件。

cues.en: So we're going to right-click and say, Manage NuGet Package and find that package.
cues.zh: 按右鍵開啟管理 NuGet 套件，再尋找它。

cues.en: What you will notice is that this package, which is here,
cues.zh: 可以注意到這裡的套件，

cues.en: isn't stable, which is good.
cues.zh: 現在已經是穩定版，這很好。

cues.en: This is only a recent addition.
cues.zh: 這是最近才更新的。

cues.en: It was in preview for quite a while because the underlying package was in preview.
cues.zh: 之前因為底層套件還在預覽，所以也預覽了很久。

cues.en: But now we are in a final stable version, hence this video.
cues.zh: 現在終於有穩定版本，因此才錄製這支影片。

cues.en: So we're going to install this package, accept it.
cues.zh: 安裝套件，接受相關條款。

cues.en: And now that we have that, we can actually work with agents and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 完成後，就能開始建立代理程式。

cues.en: But like any of the others, we need to make a raw client first in order to turn it into an agent.
cues.zh: 和其他供應商一樣，要先建立原生用戶端，再轉成代理程式。

cues.en: And in Entropic's case, it's simply called an Entropic Client.
cues.zh: Anthropic 的用戶端就叫 AnthropicClient。

cues.en: And it's in the namespace Entropic up here.
cues.zh: 位於上方的 Anthropic 命名空間。

cues.en: So we're going to make a new of these.
cues.zh: 建立新的執行個體。

cues.en: And in it, we can set the API key.
cues.zh: 在裡面設定 ApiKey。

cues.en: So that is our key.
cues.zh: 填入剛才的金鑰。

cues.en: And that is actually everything we need to set up.
cues.zh: 設定上只需要這些。

cues.en: We don't need to specify an endpoint or anything because that is just routed through the client.
cues.zh: 不必另外指定端點，用戶端會使用預設服務。

cues.en: And once we have the client,
cues.zh: 取得用戶端之後，

cues.en: which we call client so it's easier for us to see here,
cues.zh: 這裡命名為 client，方便閱讀，

cues.en: we can simply say as AI agent.
cues.zh: 就能直接呼叫 AsAIAgent。

cues.en: And when we do this, we have options for say, model instructions and such things.
cues.zh: 這裡可以指定模型、指示等選項。

cues.en: But because Entropic requires normally a max output tokens, we can technically use this.
cues.zh: 不過 Anthropic 通常要求 MaxOutputTokens，雖然也能用這個簡單多載，

cues.en: But I would recommend that you always use the chat client agent options so you can set that max output token.
cues.zh: 我會建議一律使用 ChatClientAgentOptions，方便明確設定輸出上限。

cues.en: Because without setting it, it will actually just set it for 1024 tokens, which might not be enough for what you do.
cues.zh: 如果不設定，預設只有 1,024 個 Token，可能不足以完成工作。

cues.en: So I will always do it as this with new chat client options here.
cues.zh: 所以我通常像這樣建立 ChatClientAgentOptions。

cues.en: And inside here, we will say that the chat options are a new set of chat options where we'll set the two minimal things we need to do model ID,
cues.zh: 裡面再建立 ChatOptions，指定最基本的兩項：ModelId，

cues.en: which is the model and max output tokens.
cues.zh: 也就是模型，以及 MaxOutputTokens。

cues.en: In my case, let me set it to 10,000 instead of the default 1024, which I will find two tokens.
cues.zh: 這裡設定一萬，取代我認為偏少的預設 1,024。

cues.en: It will be annoying if you suddenly have your agent running, and it suddenly runs out of output tokens.
cues.zh: 避免代理程式執行到一半，突然用完輸出 Token。

cues.en: So doing this, we simply get our agents.
cues.zh: 設定完成，就會取得代理程式。

cues.en: This is a chat client agent, but can also just be the AI agents as we know it.
cues.zh: 這是 ChatClientAgent，也可以當成一般 AIAgent 使用。

cues.en: And now we're ready to use the agent.
cues.zh: 現在可以開始呼叫。

cues.en: And that happens like any other agent can do.
cues.zh: 用法和其他代理程式一樣，

cues.en: And that happens like any other agent framework provider in that we can say run async and give a question.
cues.zh: 也和其他供應商相同，呼叫 RunAsync，再提供問題。

cues.en: So for example, what is the capital of France?
cues.zh: 例如：「法國首都是哪裡？」

cues.en: To do that, we need to await it, and we get a response object back.
cues.zh: 使用 await 等待後，取得回覆物件。

cues.en: This response object have a bunch of features that I cover in various other videos.
cues.zh: 這個物件有很多功能，其他影片有詳細介紹。

cues.en: It has a text, which is the broad text back.
cues.zh: 例如 Text，代表完整的文字回覆。

cues.en: But because we have that to do to string value will automatically use text, we can simply just write console.writeline response.
cues.zh: 但因為 ToString 會自動回傳 Text，所以可以直接 Console.WriteLine(response)。

cues.en: So if we run this, we should see that we will get an answer back.
cues.zh: 執行後，應該就能看到答案。

cues.en: And the capital of France is Paris.
cues.zh: 法國的首都是巴黎。

cues.en: So this was just a raw request response.
cues.zh: 這只是一般請求與回應。

cues.en: If we want to have streaming results, we can also do that in that we can say run streaming async
cues.zh: 如果要串流，也能呼叫 RunStreamingAsync，

cues.en: and ask a question, for example, how to make soup.
cues.zh: 提出例如如何煮湯的問題。

cues.en: This one is an await for each.
cues.zh: 這次要使用 await foreach。

cues.en: So we are going to get an update back, meaning an update is more or less one word at a time.
cues.zh: 逐次取得 update，大致就是一小段一小段文字。

cues.en: And for that reason, we were going to say console.write of the update instead.
cues.zh: 因此改成 Console.Write(update)。

cues.en: Just going to make a console.writeline here so we can see when one begins and the other one ends.
cues.zh: 中間加一個 Console.WriteLine，方便區分前一段結束、下一段開始。

cues.en: When one begins and the other one runs.
cues.zh: 讓兩種回覆更容易辨認。

cues.en: And if we do it like this, we can see and run it again.
cues.zh: 像這樣再次執行，

cues.en: See first, our answer capital of France come back in one go.
cues.zh: 首先會一次取得法國首都的答案。

cues.en: And here we see the streaming on the fly on how to make soup in our case.
cues.zh: 接著則會逐段串流輸出如何煮湯。

cues.en: So Antropic is a bit different in that we need to set this max output tokens.
cues.zh: 所以 Anthropic 比較不同的地方，就是要明確指定 MaxOutputTokens。

cues.en: Again, if you don't set it by default, it will be 1024.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，未指定時預設是 1,024。

cues.en: There's also one other thing that is a bit special about them.
cues.zh: 另外還有一件比較特別的事。

cues.en: And for that reason, I'm just going to comment out these two others and try to use structured output.
cues.zh: 先把前面兩個範例註解掉，改用結構化輸出。

cues.en: Because if in structured output, you can normally say agents, and structured output for those who don't know is we get it back in a structured format of JSON
cues.zh: 一般可以在代理程式上使用結構化輸出，也就是取得 JSON 格式，

cues.en: that we can turn into an object.
cues.zh: 再轉成物件。

cues.en: So if we do this, and we go in and make a class here, public class location.
cues.zh: 這裡先建立 public class Location。

cues.en: And we make a quick little thing here with a string of country.
cues.zh: 裡面加一個字串 Country，

cues.en: And capital city.
cues.zh: 以及 CapitalCity。

cues.en: So this is how we do it with structured output.
cues.zh: 這就是結構化輸出的資料結構。

cues.en: And then we tell a answer the question, ask this object.
cues.zh: 然後要求模型用這個物件回答問題。

cues.en: So what was it called? Location.
cues.zh: 型別叫 Location，

cues.en: Put that up here.
cues.zh: 放到這裡。

cues.en: I have dedicated videos about structured output.
cues.zh: 結構化輸出另有專門的影片。

cues.en: I have dedicated videos about structured output.
cues.zh: 我已經有相關的獨立介紹。

cues.en: So we can, for example, say the location with the Eiffel Tower.
cues.zh: 例如要求提供艾菲爾鐵塔所在地的資訊。

cues.en: And we get a response back here as well.
cues.zh: 同樣會取得回覆，

cues.en: And now it's a response of location.
cues.zh: 但現在是包含 Location 的回覆。

cues.en: But what we will see here is that if I say console.writeline of agent response.
cues.zh: 接著用 Console.WriteLine 輸出 AgentResponse，

cues.en: And now, of course, I have my results and can go in and say the country.
cues.zh: 當然也可以透過 Result 取得 Country，

cues.en: So I can say country is this.
cues.zh: 例如輸出國家，

cues.en: And capital is the capital.
cues.zh: 以及首都。

cues.en: This would work in OpenAI and others.
cues.zh: 這在 OpenAI 與其他供應商都能使用。

cues.en: But in Claude, it seemingly don't work because if we run this, we will get an error message
cues.zh: 但 Claude 看起來不行，執行後會收到錯誤，

cues.en: instead of response back here.
cues.zh: 而不是正常取得這裡的結果。

cues.en: And it says it is not a valid object here.
cues.zh: 它表示內容不是有效的物件。

cues.en: And if we set a breakpoint, we will be able to see why.
cues.zh: 設中斷點就能看到原因。

cues.en: Because this is just the text and this cannot be turned into JSON
cues.zh: 因為這裡只是一般文字，無法轉成 JSON，

cues.en: and therefore it can't use this result part.
cues.zh: 所以 Result 不能成功解析。

cues.en: And this is actually a bug that has been reported but has not been changed yet.
cues.zh: 這其實是已回報、但尚未修正的問題。

cues.en: It might have been fixed by the time you're seeing this.
cues.zh: 你看到影片時，也許已經修好了。

cues.en: But what we need to do is that we need to tell that these need to be required.
cues.zh: 目前的解法，是把這些屬性標記為 required。

cues.en: This is good practice in C-sharp anyway.
cues.zh: 這在 C# 本來就是不錯的習慣。

cues.en: But if we don't make them required, it won't begin to generate the structured output format.
cues.zh: 不加 required，它就不會正確產生結構化輸出。

cues.en: But if we do it like this, this is in other systems, it will still make an object back.
cues.zh: 其他供應商即使不加，也仍會回傳物件，

cues.en: But in Claude, it won't.
cues.zh: 但 Claude 不會。

cues.en: But now we can see that our structure back here is actually the object.
cues.zh: 現在可以看到，回傳內容確實變成物件了。

cues.en: And we can read out these properties and get back the country and the capital.
cues.zh: 因此能讀取屬性，取得國家與首都。

cues.en: So that's just a little thing you need to be noticing if you're using Claude compared to the others that don't need these required keywords down here.
cues.zh: 這是使用 Claude 時要留意的小差異，其他供應商不一定需要 required。

cues.en: But again, it's good practice, so just then, just type it.
cues.zh: 不過既然這是好習慣，就直接加上。

cues.en: So there you have it.
cues.zh: 這樣就完成了。

cues.en: Very different like the others, except just for max output tokens and the way that structured output works.
cues.zh: 除了 MaxOutputTokens 與結構化輸出的細節，和其他供應商差異不大。

cues.en: But else, this code is exactly the same as any of the other providers, which is the key strength of Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 其餘程式碼完全相同，這正是 Microsoft Agent Framework 的主要優點。

cues.en: So with that, thank you and see you on the next one.
cues.zh: 謝謝收看，我們下支影片見。
